name: Tamoxifen
summary: Tamoxifen, marketed under the brand name Nolvadex (among others), is a selective estrogen receptor modulator sometimes used in breast cancer drug regimens for women and men. It is also being studied for other types of cancer. It has been used for Albright syndrome. Tamoxifen is usually administered orally for five years for breast cancer.

pharmacology.text: Tamoxifen, marketed under the brand name Nolvadex (among others), is a selective estrogen receptor modulator sometimes used in breast cancer drug regimens for women and men. Tamoxifen is a selective estrogen-receptor modulator (SERM) and works by decreasing the growth of breast cancer cells.

sideEffects.text: Serious side effects of tamoxifen can include increased risk of uterine cancer, stroke, ophthalmological problems, and pulmonary embolisms. Common side effects include irregular periods, weight loss, and hot flashes.
